content: we minimize the binary cross entropy loss $\mathcal {L}_s$ , and in practise, $\text{Sigmoid}(f(\mathbf {v}_\ast ))$ should be transformed by applying a fully connected neural network $f(\cdot )$ with one hidden layer. With an analogy to the Masked LM task in BERT, we also used specific symbol [MASK] to randomly replace the original medical code $c_\ast \in \mathcal {C}_\ast ^1$ . So there are $15\%$ codes in $\mathcal {C}_\ast $ which will be replaced randomly and the model should have the ability to predict the masked code based on others.
